verdict.rationale: Shopify POS includes an AI assistant (Sidekick), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows Sidekick or POS acting as an MCP client or consuming tools from external MCP servers. POS UI extensions and Admin API access are developer building blocks, not MCP client support, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
